product_metadata.title: Stonebriar Tall 3x6 Inch Unscented Pillar Candles,White, 6 count
features: Our candles are poured and over dipped with only the best quality paraffin wax to ensure a long lasting 65 hour burn time
Pillar candles are made with lead-free 100% cotton wicks for a clean and smoke free burn
These 3x6 pillar candles are the perfect size for large and medium candle lanterns, glass hurricanes, centerpieces, and fireplace mantel decorations
Candle set can be used as every day decor, decoration for parties, unity candles for weddings, or emergency candles for power failure
Pillar candle set comes wrapped in a sturdy divided cardboard box to ensure candles arrive neatly packaged and undamaged
description: Brighten up your home with Stonebriar's 6 pack tall 3 x 6 inch 65 hour long burning unscented white wax pillar candles. These pillar candles are poured with quality paraffin wax and feature an extended burn time of 65 hours. Each candle comes with a lead free and 100% cotton wick for a clean smoke-free burn. Pillar candles can be used with any decor whether it be a beautiful centerpiece for the holidays, an upscale romantic restaurant setting, unity candles for a wedding, or a relaxing spa atmosphere. Candle set is also great to keep handy as emergency survival candles for power failures. Stonebriar round pillar candles measure 3 inches by 6 inches and are the perfect size for large and medium candle lanterns, decorative centerpieces, fireplace and mantel decoration, or simply to enhance any table top in your home.
